item.title: A Few Things to Do After Installing CentOS
item.description: 1. Replacing the Repository Mirror First, back up the official repository. 1 mv /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo.backup Download the new repository to /etc/yum.repos.d/ CentOS 5 1 wget -O /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo http://mirrors.aliyun.com/repo/Centos-5.repo CentOS 6 1 wget -O /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo http://mirrors.aliyun.com/repo/Centos-6.repo CentOS 7 1 wget -O /etc/yum.repos.d/CentOS-Base.repo http://mirrors.aliyun.com/repo/Centos-7.repo Generate the metadata cache. 1 yum makecache 2.
